task: Targeted primary-source check for a physical-parity midpoint pulse, echo-pair complete positivity, and entropy inference
conclusion: Echo protocols, adjoint reversal and Hellinger overlap machinery are established. No direct precedent for the specific copositive endpoint certificate was located in this bounded search; no historical-priority claim is made.

sources.title: Stochastic Echo Phenomena in Nonequilibrium Systems
sources.journal: Journal of the Korean Physical Society 64, 504
sources.read: Introduction and sections II–IV, especially equations (9), (10), and (25)–(27)
sources.bearing: Protocol-optimized reversed path ensembles; a stationary-distribution-dependent dual force realizes perfect stochastic echo for arbitrary overdamped steady states. Distinct from applying one fixed physical state involution followed by unchanged dynamics.

sources.authors: Becker, Willaert, Cleuren and Van den Broeck
sources.title: Echo states for detailed fluctuation theorems
sources.version: Inspected arXiv:1405.6064v2, 2015-01-06; published Physical Review E 91, 012101
sources.bearing: Echo initial distributions and forward/reversed/adjoint propagator composition for detailed fluctuation theorems. Confirms preparation conditions; not a coarse endpoint CP certificate.

sources.title: Entropy production of a closed Hamiltonian system via the detailed fluctuation relation
sources.read: Introduction; section II including Figure 1, velocity-reversal protocol and distinction between the information-theoretic entropy quantity and thermodynamic entropy
sources.bearing: Closest located physical operation: midpoint velocity reversal plus Gaussian finite-resolution smearing. Its entropy target is explicitly not thermodynamic entropy production.

sources.title: Irreversibility, Loschmidt Echo, and Thermodynamic Uncertainty Relation
sources.version: Inspected arXiv:2101.06831v5 HTML, version dated 2021-12-08; published Physical Review Letters 127, 240602
sources.read: Introduction and main Results through equations (8)–(12), including two-sided Lindblad overlap operator and Hellinger bounds
sources.bearing: Existing trajectory overlap, two-sided generator and Hellinger machinery. Not the proposed classical copositive endpoint constraint under one faithful physical parity pulse.
sources.retrieval_note: arXiv PDF returned DisabledError and publisher PDF returned HTTP 401; the main-paper HTML was available and read. A regenerated HTML display date was not treated as publication metadata.

search_families: velocity or momentum reversal entropy inference
reflection positivity or copositive entropy echo
scope_guards: The actual operation must implement the supplied physical involution on all relevant hidden states.
The stationary distribution must be invariant under that involution for the stated stationary two-half KL rate identity.
An adjoint dynamics or freely optimized control is a different, stronger resource than the fixed parity pulse.
Generalized path-KL entropy is not automatically the heat dissipation of an unspecified physical device.
The pulse apparatus implementation cost is separate from the stationary generator's entropy rate.
Conventional observed-pair KL and hidden-model optimization remain equally informed comparators.
Passing a CP witness is not a sufficient criterion for a common full equilibrium realization.
execution: Literature and algebraic scope review only; no physical pulse, equipment operation, or empirical acquisition was performed.
